faq.q: What happens in the free 20-min AI consultation?
faq.a: Our AI specialist asks how your business runs, finds where you're losing time or customers, and shows you what we'd build first. You leave with a clear plan and a price. No cost and no obligation.

An AI front desk that answers every call and books appointments, lead follow-up, workflow automation for quotes, invoices, reminders and reports, custom AI agents for your team, and the integration that connects your phone, calendar, CRM, email, accounting and website.

faq.q: Do I have to change my tools?
faq.a: No. We build around the tools you already use and connect them. Nothing gets ripped out.
Plans start at $197 a month. Your exact price depends on what you need, and you get it in your free consultation, before we build anything. Book before December 31 and setup is free.
No. Every plan is month-to-month. Stay because it works, not because you signed for a year.

faq.q: Will my customers know they're talking to an AI?
faq.a: Yes. Donna always says she's an AI, and anyone who wants a person gets a call back. You approve every word before a customer hears it.
Monitoring, fixes and tuning are included in your plan. You won't get a separate bill when something needs fixing.
Your data stays yours. We only use it to run what we build for you, and we never sell it.

calculator.meta_description: Estimate what missed calls cost your business each month, and what answering them could bring back. The math runs in your browser.
calculator.title: What are missed calls
calculator.subtitle: Pick your type of business for example values, then change the four numbers to yours. The math runs in your browser and nothing you type is sent anywhere.
calculator.presets_note: Example values for a small business of that type, to start from. They are not research and not a promise: replace them with your own numbers.

notes.calls_per_week: Example value. Use your own count from your phone bill or call log.
notes.missed_pct: Starting value from industry research: 27% of calls to home services businesses go unanswered (Invoca, 2024), used for home services; 28% of calls to businesses go unanswered (CallRail, 2025), used for the other types. Your audit shows your real number.
notes.job_value: Example value. Use what a new customer is worth to you on average: a job, a visit, a case or a commission.
notes.close_pct: Example value. Of the new callers who reach you, how many become paying customers?
notes.recover_pct: Donna.AI planning assumption, not a measured result: the share of missed callers who would still book if they were answered, or texted back within minutes. Donna.AI has no client data yet.

sources.label: Invoca, How much missed sales calls cost home services businesses (2024-05-23)
CallRail, How missed calls are costing your business (2025-09-11)

calculator.disclaimer: Estimates for planning only. Not every missed call is a new job: some are existing customers, spam, or callers who reach you later. Lower the numbers if that fits your business.
calculator.cta_text: The calculator uses estimates. The free missed-call audit uses your own line: we call it during the day and after hours, the way a new customer would, and show you what happened.

privacy.p: From the contact form: your name, business name, phone, email, your message, the time you sent it and whether you ticked the optional marketing box. From a conversation with Donna, our AI receptionist, on this website or by phone: a recording and transcript of the call, an automatic summary, the details you choose to share (such as your name, business, email and the problem you want solved) and, for phone calls, your phone number. From a booking: your name, email and the time you picked.
Every call starts by telling you that you are speaking with an AI and that the call is recorded. If you do not want to be recorded, end the call and use the contact form or email us instead.

To answer your inquiry, book and hold your consultation, follow up about it, and improve how Donna answers. If you ticked the marketing box, also to send you occasional messages about our services. We do not sell your information.

Netlify (website hosting and forms), Retell AI (voice calls, recordings and transcripts, using AI speech and language models from its providers), Cal.com (bookings), Google (email) and Telegram (instant alerts to our team about new requests). Some of these providers store or process data outside Canada, including in the United States, where it may be accessible to authorities under local law.

Call recordings and transcripts are kept by our voice provider for 30 days, then deleted. Form submissions and booking details are kept for up to 24 months after our last contact, unless you become a client, in which case your client agreement applies. [OWNER: confirm these periods.]
Every marketing message identifies us and includes a way to unsubscribe. You can withdraw consent at any time by replying STOP to a text, using the unsubscribe link in an email, or writing to us.
This site does not use advertising or analytics cookies.

You can ask to see, correct or delete your information, or ask questions about this policy, by writing to us at the contact above. If you are not satisfied with our answer, you can contact the Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada.

terms.p: The free 20-minute AI consultation is free and carries no obligation. Any plan or project starts only after you accept a written quote or agreement.
We describe our services on this site. We build and run AI systems for your business, but we do not promise a specific number of calls, bookings, customers, sales or savings.
Plans start at $197 a month. Prices are in Canadian dollars, plus applicable taxes. Your exact price is in your written quote or agreement, and that price applies.
Monthly plans are month-to-month with no long-term contract. Notice and cancellation terms are in your agreement.
Setup is free for plans booked before December 31, 2026 (setup is otherwise $497, $997 or $1,497 depending on the plan). The offer ends on that date.
Donna is an AI. Calls with Donna are recorded and transcribed as described in our Privacy Policy.
Provided as is, for information only.
